**Open grants and calls for an Ohio adult coding-training nonprofit** (checked 2026-11-14)
Seek grants for expansion to two more Ohio counties, using the supplied captured pages only. 3 open programs, including 1 conditional eligibility match; nearest deadline December 5, 2026.

| # | Program | Funder | Amount | Fee | Match | Deadline | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Ohio Digital Skills Expansion Grant, FY2027](https://workforce.ohio.example/grants/digital-skills-2027) | Ohio workforce grant program | Up to $150,000 for 18 months; 10% local match | Not stated | met: Ohio nonprofit delivering adult workforce training | January 15, 2027, 5:00 PM Eastern | Medium |
| 2 | [Community Tech Fund, 2026-27 round](https://buckeyefoundation.example/community-tech-fund) | Buckeye Foundation | $10,000–$40,000 | Not stated | met: Ohio nonprofit teaching digital skills | December 5, 2026, 11:59 PM Eastern | Medium |
| 3 | [Lakeshore Scale Grants](https://lakeshorefoundation.example/grants/scale) | Lakeshore Foundation | $250,000–$500,000, multi-year | Not stated | check: annual operating budget must be at least $5 million; budget unknown | Rolling | High |

**Start this week:** Draft Community Tech Fund's two-page proposal and budget first. In parallel, scope the Ohio grant's 18-month expansion and confirm matching funds. For Lakeshore, check budget eligibility and evidence of proven results before developing a proposal. Effort ratings are estimates, not stated application requirements.

**Source conflict:** The [aggregator](https://grantlist.example/ohio/community-tech-fund) lists December 31 for Community Tech Fund, but the funder's current page says December 5; use December 5. The aggregator is not a separate opportunity.

**Near misses:** [Digital Futures Fund](https://digitalfutures.example/fund) has only a closed 2025 cycle and an unannounced 2026 cycle in the supplied capture. [Workforce Pathways for Adults, ETA-26-112](https://grants-portal.example/opportunity/ETA-26-112) closed October 30, 2026.

**To settle:** Confirm the annual operating budget and proven-program evidence for Lakeshore, and capacity and acceptable contributions for Ohio's required local match. Entry fees are not stated on any shortlisted page; that does not establish that applications are free.

**Verification scope:** Sources are the user-supplied captures, not independently fetched pages. The open-program captures are dated November 14, 2026; the Digital Futures capture is dated March 1, 2025. No independent second-source verification was available within the supplied-source restriction.

_This is not tax, legal or financial advice. The match is a screen, not a determination; confirm with the funder before applying._
